sections.description: Which parts to return. `summary` is totals only; `income`, `expenses`, `debts` and `savings` are the individual line items. `income_plan` says whether income varies, what a lean, typical and good month work out to, and what those figures rest on, check-ins included. `income_band` is the same from what the user declared alone. `completeness` says whether the profile is complete enough to rely on. `expense_details` gives each expense its tier, its monthly equivalent and its due date. `obligations` lists bills that come less often than monthly, which monthly totals spread out, and what to set aside for them.
